scope_note: Authorizes the account_governor_action_adapter to run --enforce against the policy whose sha256 is trigger_policy_sha256, and nothing else. Does not authorize AutoTrading, deployment, a risk change, or a freeze lift. Level-2 enforcement additionally requires --allow-l2-flatten-overaction because the halt channel has no entry-freeze-only mode; level 1 is not expressible on this channel at all and is refused by design.
